text:
rachel-partnerships: Kicking off MarisAI onboarding - need clarity on distro rights, escrow signing, and marketplace SKU taxonomy before we schedule HW handoffs. tagging @tom-legal and @devin-eng.
tom-legal: Quick flags: MarisAI's contributor CLA has a narrow redistribution grant. If we expose weights for download or allow SI appliance bundles, we need a redistribution addendum + escrow instructions. They also require provenance disclosure for training datasets.
devin-eng: For clarity from engineering: downloads = full weight tarball + tokenizer + sample pipeline. Appliance bundle = quantized weights + runtime binary. Need to know whether SIs can ship runtime optimizations (closed source) and whether we must verify integrity at runtime (checksums/signatures).
aisha-marketing: Marketing wants a hosted trial tile (30-day demo) in marketplace with "Try hosted demo" CTA. Partner asks that demo not leak to press until KMS integration is green. We need embargo rules and logo usage guidance from legal.
corey-sre: Operational note: hosted demo will be pinned to a soft-quota pool; please provide model-variant tags: e.g., marisai-v1.fp16 and marisai-v1.4bit. Also we require a artifacts manifest with sha256 entries for each file. Example manifest snippet: `{"model":"marisai-v1","files":[{"path":"weights-4bit.bin","sha256":"<hex>"}]}`.
tom-legal: We can't accept embedded PII telemetry. Telemetry must be aggregated, opt-in, and documented. For redistribution addendum: propose geofenced grant (NA + EU) for SI/hw partners, and escrowed weights only to verified SI legal entities with signed addendum.
rachel-partnerships: Hardware partner (NorthEdge) has asked for a 60-day embargo from binary receipt. Partner also wants the ability to preload models on appliances sold to enterprise customers in APAC; that's a geo + redistribution ask.
aisha-marketing: 60 days will delay press. Can we offer hosted preview tile earlier (hosted-only preview) so channel partners can start testing?
tom-legal: Hosted preview is ok under the same redistribution addendum but with stricter telemetry and an explicit "no-download" flag for preview. Will draft escrow language for weights release windows and escrow agent contact block.
devin-eng: For the appliance integrity check: suggest an onboarding endpoint that verifies signed manifest and runs a short suite of prompts + outputs hash check. I'll open PR: github.com/redwood/integrations/pull/789 with spec. Also propose a required runtime manifest field `runtime_injects=false` to indicate runtime must not alter weights.
corey-sre: +1 on test harness. We'll need to record CI results and link them in marketplace listing metadata. Also recommend a periodic smoke-check every 30 days if SIs host a runtime.
aisha-marketing: timeline ask: if binary drop happens at 3410603600 and embargo 60 days, press release target is 3410779600. Marketing needs final wording + co-brand logos 14 business days before that.
rachel-partnerships: Action list: - tom-legal: draft redistribution addendum + escrow clause (due 3410609000) - devin-eng: PR for manifest + integrity API (PR opened, spec due 3410608200) - corey-sre: CI check list + smoke cadence (due 3410609000) - aisha-marketing: draft hosted preview tile copy + co-brand blurb (due 3410612000)
tom-legal: One more legal Q: do we allow SIs to distribute model with quantization modifications done by the SI (e.g., custom quant pipeline)? My read: allowed if weights are derivable and original attribution retained; require a derivation manifest and an output-stability clause (drift threshold).
devin-eng: We can validate derivation if SI provides a diff manifest and deterministic seed. We'll require an acceptance test: run canonical prompts and ensure mean-token-delta < 0.02 BLEU-like score (or agreed metric). I'll include test harness in PR.
release-bot: ci/integrations -> success (build 623) at 3410600700
corey-sre: HW partner negotiation update: NorthEdge suggests 45 days instead of 60 if we provide a refundable early-access credit for their SI customers. Elaine? (cc'ing rachel)
aisha-marketing: If we go 45 days, marketing still needs 10 business days for enterprise briefing packs. We need final embargo by EOD Tue to lock the comms calendar.
tom-legal: I'll draft two variants: 45-day and 60-day embargo clauses, and include a clause for early-access credit mechanics.
rachel-partnerships: Great. We'll aim to finalize drafts this week. If anyone has redlines to the redistribution addendum, post them on the PR thread. Otherwise I'll compile a partner one-pager and share in partners repo. Thanks all. :shipit:
